name: Robot
desc: A 58-block-tall mech robot in blue and black terracotta: horned helmet, glass-pane armour panels, wall-block joints, stair details and hidden light blocks inside.

name: Boat1
desc: Small sailing ship in dark oak and birch: curved stair hull, three spruce masts with yards, a cabin with doors and tinted windows, lanterns, chests and banners.

name: House 1
desc: Cosy oak and spruce cottage with a curved stone roof, timber framing, cross gables, a stone chimney and red-curtained windows.

name: Boat 2
desc: Black-sailed pirate galleon in deepslate and blackstone: three masts with rope ladders, flags, cannons along both sides and a lantern-lit stern.

name: Boat 3
desc: Huge four-masted sailing ship, over 100 blocks long: billowing brown sails, rigging lines, flags, a stone-trimmed deck and rows of gun ports.
